definitionZh: 网格区 CSS 的短手属性通过贡献一条线,一个跨,或无(自动)于其网格位置来指定网格项目在一个网格内的大小和位置,从而指定其网格区域的边缘.
sourceDefinition: The grid-area CSS shorthand property specifies a grid item's size and location within a grid by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement, thereby specifying the edges of its grid areas.
